input: Two disjoint windows from one flow. Frames [0, 50) and [100, 150), each with shape (50, 20, 36) in (t, y, x) order.
optimized_changes: Native plain fit memoization, frequency projection and no-op swap changes applied in isolation to the baseline.
objectives: WAPE for u, v, p, then dyadic coefficient instability for u, v, p. Minimize all six.
pareto_scope: All returned systems across all levels in each arm, using strict full-vector Pareto dominance. Equal scores retained.
registered_support_criterion: All active terms and the intercept must match in one equation, independent of slot and target. Both registered continuity-based momentum rewrites are allowed. Complete requires all three laws in one system.
reference_supports_description: reference_supports lists direct nonconstant term matches under the PIC canonical token metric. registered_laws also checks the intercept and accepts registered momentum rewrites.
